up: For all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL3436043, return the exact activity values, standard relation, standard units, standard type, and the canonical SMILES structure.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436043' AND a.standard_relation = '=';
